theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.Φt_mul_reidx {L L' : Type} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] [Fintype L'] [DecidableEq L'] (Ψ : DrinfeldAssociator.Associator) {c : ℂ} (hc : Transcendental ℚ c) (e : L ≃ L') (S T U V : Finset L') :
Φt Ψ hc S T U V * reidx e = reidx e * Φt Ψ hc (Finset.map e.symm.toEmbedding S) (Finset.map e.symm.toEmbedding T) (Finset.map e.symm.toEmbedding U) (Finset.map e.symm.toEmbedding V)
